methodology: ESPN's current 600-player status feed is refreshed first. Curated overrides are then used only when a dated team or league report is newer or more specific than the provider label. Rank penalties affect the live decision board, while original consensus rank and official Boris tier remain visible for comparison. An override is revised or cleared when a newer report changes the player's outlook.

entries.headline: Minor knee hyperextension; Chase says he is fine
entries.detail: Chase said he could have continued practicing after the awkward landing and the club has not indicated a Week 1 availability concern. The generic ESPN questionable penalty is cleared while the news remains visible.

entries.headline: Torn ACL; expected to miss the 2026 season
entries.detail: The season-ending designation removes Higgins from optimized draft plans, sets his 2026 availability and projection to zero, and moves him to the bottom live tier.

entries.headline: Sprained MCL; expected to miss at least one month
entries.detail: The live board discounts his draft rank and season-long weekly expectation for missed early-season time while retaining his healthy-game PPG as context.

entries.headline: Season-ending PCL surgery; placed on injured reserve
entries.detail: Pearsall is excluded from every 2026 optimized draft plan and assigned zero expected weekly production.

entries.headline: Season-ending LCL surgery; rookie year over
entries.detail: Carolina announced that Brazzell will miss the full 2026 season, so the live boards and plans assign zero availability.

entries.headline: Placed on injured reserve; current tracker lists no 2026 return
entries.detail: Ford is treated as unavailable until Washington supplies a return designation. The dated override can be relaxed immediately if that changes.

entries.headline: Reserve/PUP confirmed; will miss at least four games
entries.detail: Seattle placed Charbonnet on Reserve/PUP at final cuts. He cannot play before Week 5, so the season projection and live rank now reflect a guaranteed four-game absence while healthy-game PPG remains visible.

entries.headline: Hamstring injury; expected to miss roughly two months
entries.detail: The latest league report points to a multi-game absence extending well beyond Week 1. His healthy-game ceiling stays visible, but the season projection and live rank reflect the expected missed time.

entries.headline: Hyperextended knee; expected to miss multiple weeks
entries.detail: The MRI outcome was considered positive, but missed camp work and possible Week 1 uncertainty reduce his current live rank and weekly expectation modestly.

entries.headline: Activated from PUP; ramping up in individual work
entries.detail: Kittle is no longer on PUP. San Francisco still describes Week 1 as possible rather than certain, so the board carries only a small readiness discount instead of a multi-game absence.

entries.headline: Ankle recovery still being assessed ahead of Week 1
entries.detail: Las Vegas says Jeanty remains on the mend and will be evaluated for another week, while also saying the team is counting on him for the opener. The board keeps a modest readiness discount without projecting a multi-game absence.

entries.headline: Placed on Commissioner's Exempt List; return date unknown
entries.detail: This is an availability designation rather than an injury. Jacobs cannot practice or play while exempt, and there is no announced resolution date. The live board applies a major uncertainty discount instead of treating the ESPN day-to-day groin label as the primary issue.

entries.headline: On track to start Week 1 after strong ACL-rehab camp
entries.detail: Mahomes remains a post-ACL monitoring case, but the latest national report says he is on track for the opener. The model retains only a minimal readiness adjustment; his historical durability signal remains separate.

entries.headline: Avoided serious ankle injury; expected to be ready Week 1
entries.detail: The latest league-source report says Henderson should be good to go for the opener. The generic ESPN questionable rank penalty is cleared while the recent ankle issue remains visible in his profile.

entries.headline: Groin recovery remains on track for Week 1
entries.detail: New York still expects Hall to be available for the opener. The model keeps a small readiness and possible early workload discount rather than the undifferentiated ESPN questionable penalty.

entries.headline: Returned to team drills after hip flare-up
entries.detail: LaPorta returned to practice and took team repetitions, materially improving the earlier uncertain Week 1 outlook. A minimal readiness discount remains until regular-season injury reports begin.

entries.headline: Removed from Active/PUP; cleared to begin practicing
entries.detail: Indianapolis activated Pierce on August 27. He still needs a post-surgery ramp-up, but the prior risk of an automatic four-game PUP absence is gone and the live board now carries only a minimal readiness discount.

entries.headline: Returned to practice after psoas soreness
entries.detail: Nacua returned to the field on August 30 after nearly three weeks of managed work. His elite role remains intact; only a minimal readiness discount remains until full Week 1 participation is confirmed.

entries.headline: ACL rehab progressing; practicing without non-contact jersey
entries.detail: Nabers was moving better than the Giants had previously seen after shedding the red jersey. The club has not guaranteed Week 1, so the model retains a moderate ACL-readiness discount while improving his outlook from the earlier rehab stage.

entries.headline: High-ankle sprain; Week 1 remains uncertain
entries.detail: Arizona has not ruled Love out for the opener, but high-ankle recovery and lost preseason work justify a meaningful availability discount until he returns to full practice.

entries.headline: Groin injury managed with Week 1 readiness in mind
entries.detail: Indianapolis may hold Warren out of practice while deliberately managing the groin issue to have him ready for Week 1. No extended absence has been announced, so the model applies a small readiness adjustment only.

entries.headline: Toe injury; Week 1 availability uncertain
entries.detail: Tampa Bay describes Egbuka as day-to-day or week-to-week. The role-based upside remains, but the league ranks now include a short-term availability penalty.

entries.headline: Hamstring recovery; targeting the opener
entries.detail: Carolina still lists Hubbard first on the depth chart, but is planning a Hubbard/Jonathon Brooks rotation once both are available. The current rank accounts for both the hamstring and shared-workload risk.

entries.headline: Returned to practice after planned workload management
entries.detail: The current report says the missed practices were planned rather than a new injury setback. No current availability penalty is applied; historical durability risk remains separate.

entries.headline: Cleared after head evaluation; dealing with a stinger
entries.detail: Tracy was evaluated for a head injury and cleared. The current concern is a stinger, so the generic OUT penalty from the provider feed is replaced with a small short-term readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Head evaluation did not indicate a concussion; still monitored
entries.detail: Tennessee does not believe Robinson suffered a concussion, but will continue monitoring for delayed symptoms. The board keeps the injury visible with only a minimal readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Held out with an ankle injury; no long-term concern reported
entries.detail: Minnesota held McCarthy out of the preseason finale, but the current report says there is no long-term concern. The model applies only a minimal readiness adjustment.

entries.headline: Placed on IR with a return designation; out at least four games
entries.detail: San Francisco designated Kirk to return from injured reserve. He remains eligible later in the season, but the final-cut designation guarantees that he cannot play in the first four games.

entries.headline: Reserve/PUP confirmed; out at least four games
entries.detail: Guerendo remained on Reserve/PUP at final roster cuts, making him ineligible for the first four games. He is now modeled as an IR-stash candidate rather than usable early-season depth.

entries.headline: Placed on IR with a return designation; out at least four games
entries.detail: Houston designated Dell to return from injured reserve. He can return later in the season, but he is not eligible to play during the first four games and should be treated as an IR stash on draft day.
